scope: Second EPG pass for existing Czech Chamber Stream1, Slovakia TV NR SR and Estonia Riigikogu feeds; official page/API metadata only, no media requests or playback.
publication_limit: The two implemented parsers supply source-dated starts only. No event end, current-live state or XMLTV programme is invented from those starts. Runtime fetch results are distinct from parser reference checks.

source.notes: Only dated schuze Poslanecke snemovny blocks with official sitting links map to Stream1. Committee/social events are excluded; source supplies starts, with no invented ends.

confirmed: The official Stream 1 title explicitly identifies Chamber sittings and publishes the same permanent CRA stream1 player address already recorded in the catalogue.

The weekly plan is a mixed institutional calendar, so only the bold numbered Chamber-sitting table with its official /schuze/term/session link qualifies. Committee invitations, receptions, seminars and generic mentions of Chamber sittings are excluded.
Weekday headings contain explicit Czech day, month and year. Current and next ISO-week links are observed official navigation; request date and ISO week year are computed in Europe/Prague.

The current week contains four source-dated starts on 20–23 October. They are already past at the live collection time. The following dated weekly page has no Chamber-sitting blocks, so the current result is genuinely empty.

reference_parse.purpose: Exercise nonempty observed markup against a historical test clock only; not current published data.

integration.reviewed_feed_mapping: Stream1 Chamber sittings only; no other stream/committee mapping.
integration.xmltv_hold: All ends unknown; no XMLTV programme can be emitted without a later separately evidenced complete time range.

time_semantics.dst_policy: Ambiguous/nonexistent source-local clock raises a collection error through common.localize_source_time.
time_semantics.overnight_policy: A dated00:15 is that source day and may serialize to the previous UTC date; no cross-day end or arbitrary midnight boundary is inferred.
time_semantics.date_validation: Weekday must match explicit date and the requested local ISO week. Wrong/stale weeks, missing main-content/day labels or an unresolved recognized sitting start fail rather than report empty.

remaining_gaps: No source end timestamps were present.
The calendar does not establish broadcast plans for Stream 2–5 or unrelated event-room feeds.

source.notes: Dated plenary and question-time starts for the officially designated Session Hall feed. Does not map other rooms/Live2, infer ends or infer a live state from a past start.

confirmed: The own Session Hall page explicitly binds its Session Hall player to channel-index 0 and rk_live_1, matching existing Riigikogu Live 1.

The official documented plenary API supplies explicit response date bounds and sitting UUID, title, sittingDateTime and volumeType. Plenary and question-time volumes qualify; committee/other volumes are held.

The current official response provides five upcoming starts for 26–29 October 2026. Source clocks are naive local Tallinn times, not UTC; the first 15:00 on 26 October is 13:00Z after the autumn DST transition.
The same API response and schema expose no sitting end. A following day or following question-time/plenary start is not used to invent an end.
The public current-status endpoint says offline/no_plenary_today on 25 October; this is not a future programme listing and is not used to label past starts live.

integration.xmltv_hold: All five ends unknown; no new XMLTV programmes from these starts.

time_semantics.identity: Official per-sitting UUID, rejecting repeated identities.
time_semantics.request_window: Source-local today through seven days ahead, explicit startDate/endDate; response bounds must cover the requested local date.
time_semantics.serialization: Whole-second UTC RFC3339 plus source_timezone; explicit source offsets are respected.
time_semantics.dst_policy: Naive local clocks use common.localize_source_time and ambiguous/nonexistent clocks raise a collection error.
time_semantics.overnight_policy: A dated local midnight start can belong to the previous UTC day; no inferred end or recurrence schedule is generated.

remaining_gaps: Live 2 has an own player but no equivalent dated room/feed attribution in the examined primary programme data; do not mirror Session Hall programmes to it.

tv_homepage.interpretation: Challenge shell, not schedule availability or an empty programme result.

confirmed: The existing catalogue lists both the official TV page and general National Council meeting programme as planned sources. Neither is a proven current programme payload in this run.
remaining_gaps: No challenge bypass, cookies, browser playback or follow-up media request was attempted.
Need a reachable official dated broadcast payload and explicit mapping to the already recorded native playback feed before applying an EPG source.
A general meeting list cannot establish the TV feed content or complete broadcast intervals.

checks.shared_runtime_fetch: Both new modules fetched and parsed successfully using schedule_collection.fetch_text; no user-agent workaround required.
checks.fixtures: Focused synthetic day/table and plenary JSON fixtures only. No challenge scripts/values, full pages, media or API private material are committed.
